cases.prompt: Diagnose a null-rate rise in orders.shipping_country. The profile in reports/dq/2026-10-21.md line 12 shows `partner_b: null_rate 0.4% -> 31.2%` while every other source stays below 1%, and line 15 shows `upstream rows partner_b: 48,210 -> 48,190`. pipelines/parsers/partner_b.py line 27 changed on 2026-10-20 from `row['country']` to `row['address']['country_code']`. The join in models/orders.sql line 40, `LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.code = o.country`, is the alternative join-loss explanation. Rank the parser-change and join-loss hypotheses and name the check that separates them.
